description: Source code for a firmware image utility that constructs firmware images with multiple blocks, including boot, configuration, web pages, runtime code, and extra data, for embedded devices. It handles command-line options for specifying blocks, sizes, addresses, and target boards, and includes functions for checksum calculation, file handling, and image assembly.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses command-line arguments, processes blocks, and writes the firmware image file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options for the utility.

methods.name: process_blocks
methods.description: Calculates sizes and positions for each block based on the target device's flash size and specified parameters.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board configuration by model name from predefined list.

methods.name: parse_opt_board
methods.description: Parses and sets the board option from command-line arguments.

methods.name: parse_opt_block
methods.description: Parses block options (boot, config, web, runtime, extra) from command-line arguments.

methods.name: write_out_blocks
methods.description: Writes all configured blocks to the output firmware image file.

methods.name: block_stat_file
methods.description: Gets file size and status for a block's source file.

methods.name: block_writeout_hdr
methods.description: Writes the header for a block to the output file.

methods.name: block_writeout_file
methods.description: Reads block data from source file and writes it to output.

methods.name: block_writeout_data
methods.description: Writes block data and padding to output.

methods.name: block_writeout_csum
methods.description: Calculates and writes checksum for a block.
